chronology: original contracts and implementations entered Git together; no independently proven pre-implementation chronology is claimed for v1

environment.linking: nonzero obstructs splitting; zero does not certify splitting
environment.mapping_class: surface homeomorphism is not assumed isotopic to identity or ambiently extendible
environment.sphere: tame simple closed curves on a tame embedded sphere bound disks
environment.torus: standard unknotted torus embedded in R3 with fixed meridian/longitude basis for free-space comparison; primitive (2,3) curve is a trefoil
environment.writhe: diagram statistic, not a necessary constraint on ambient knot type

history: v1 contracts and review artifacts remain unchanged; pre-repair outputs are retained at the historical full commit and indexed by blob/hash in reviews/2026-10-19-repair-history.json

native.gate_C: literal encoding, concatenation and endpoint replay only; topological process faithfulness not certified
native.geometric_domain: finite rational PL polygons; closed polygons require at least three distinct nodes; certified positive self-embedding only for rigid translations of an exactly checked simple initial polygon
native.nontranslation: may return invalid with an exact collision witness, otherwise not-certified; never valid
native.signed_word_domain: abstract signed words and the historical R1/R2-named syntactic rewrite operations; no planar realisability, Reidemeister soundness or knot-process claim

proof_obligations: primary checks all initial edges including adjacent overlaps, nonzero edges and node distinctness; equal displacement at every breakpoint proves translation on each affine interval
secondary independently checks static simplicity using exact squared distances plus adjacent-collinearity overlap; constancy of every relative node vector proves translation
nontranslation and collapsing/overlapping/degenerate inputs never receive valid from either whole-interval route
status: narrowed research contract; no manuscript or native Adva promotion
verification: read-only immutable contract checks; explicit file inventory; normal/optimized/hash-seed runs with raw outputs regenerated in temporary directories and compared to committed evidence
